facts.row: UAT plans and the acceptance harness

facts.fact: `claude plugin install` installs at user scope by default
Headless `claude -p` has no AskUserQuestion, TodoWrite, or EnterPlanMode, even when --tools names them; Glob, Grep, and Read load when named
Headless `claude -p` loads the Artifact tool by default (2026-10-24 observation; account-dependent)
The headless init event lists the loaded agents and slash commands, so the inventory check needs no interactive `/agents` screen
`codex exec` offers --json, --ignore-user-config, and --sandbox; `codex exec resume` has no --sandbox, so a resumed turn sets sandbox_mode with -c
Codex calls shell commands (exec_command) and apply_patch; it has no Glob or Grep tool (model self-report, weaker than a platform record)
facts.observed: self-reported: apply_patch, clock__curr_time, create_goal, exec, exec_command, followup_task, get_goal, image_gen__imagegen, interrupt_agent, list_agents, list_mcp_resource_templates, list_mcp_resources

facts.fact: A Cursor CLI is installed, so Cursor facts can be rechecked headless
